title: Bulk expense import
pr_description: Adds import_expenses() so users can migrate data from other apps. Takes a list of row dicts (as parsed from CSV/JSON uploads) and returns how many were imported, skipping rows that fail validation.

defects.description: The bare except-and-continue silently drops any failing row and hides the reason. The caller gets only a count, with no way to know which rows were rejected or why; even programming errors (KeyError from a malformed dict) vanish.

Rows come from parsed CSV/JSON uploads, so amount_cents is typically a string like '12.50'. It is passed straight to add_expense and SQLite stores the TEXT value, silently corrupting later SUM aggregations. The importer must validate/convert amounts (e.g. via parse_money).
